title: First Steps: Neuronal Bursting
description: Runnable Section 9.4 scaled Hindmarsh-Rose neuronal bursting walkthrough using x10-weighted inputs, XIR/SJ, and SLOW.

walkthrough.title: Initialize the neuronal states
walkthrough.text: MINUS1 initializes I1.out to x=+1 through the inverting IC socket, ZERO initializes y, and PLUS1 initializes I3.out to -z=-1. P3 is now the 0.75*y scaling term used in the x equation.

walkthrough.title: Generate x² and x³
walkthrough.text: MUL1 squares x and MUL2 multiplies x² by x. P1 scales x² by b*10=0.6, P2 scales x³ by a*10=0.4, and the SUM1 x10 inputs produce the effective +6*x² and -4*x³ terms.

walkthrough.title: Build the x and y equations
walkthrough.text: SUM1 combines -4*x³, +6*x², +7.5*y, -z, and Iext from XIR1 to drive the x integrator. SUM2 combines c, about -1.33*x², and -y to drive the y integrator.

walkthrough.title: Use SLOW for the z channel
walkthrough.text: P5 scales x as 100rs, P6 supplies the 100rs*xr offset, and P4 scales -z as 100r. XIR2 joins the offset and damping terms, while I3.out patched to I3.slow applies the 0.01 speed factor.

walkthrough.title: Display the burst channels
walkthrough.text: OUT X carries the scaled membrane potential x as the burst train, OUT Y carries y, OUT Z carries -z, and OUT U carries positive z for diagnostics. The preset opens with X as the main time trace.
